compatibility.decision: Extend request API; preserve existing schematic response schemas
compatibility.legacy_calls: Keep legacy signal interpretation unless scoped-v1 is explicitly selected

path_rules.sheet_path: Names of sheet instances from the selected project root; not file paths
path_rules.last_segment: Net label, hierarchical port name, or issued unnamed-net anchor
path_rules.escaping: JSON Pointer segment escaping: ~ becomes ~0; / becomes ~1
path_rules.decode: Exactly once; no URL decoding, path normalization, case folding or trimming
path_rules.special_segments: . and .. are literal names, never filesystem traversal
path_rules.unqualified_names_in_scoped_mode: Reject except empty string and NC
path_rules.duplicate_sibling_sheet_names: Reject ambiguous paths; do not select a sheet by filename
path_rules.identity: Resolve names through a snapshot of instance UUID paths; reject stale context after rename or topology changes

resolution_rules.hier: An address of an existing hierarchical interface; may alias a local or global net
resolution_rules.export: All pins on one resolved electrical net receive one canonical signal_name across the selected project snapshot
resolution_rules.canonical_selection: Prefer a global binding; otherwise a named local binding at the shallowest sheet depth; otherwise a hierarchical port at the shallowest depth; otherwise an issued auto anchor. Tie-break by the exact escaped path. Keep all other accesses as aliases in the local context
resolution_rules.canonical_is_not_native_name: The adapter separately preserves native KiCad net names and all label objects; it does not reconstruct them by stripping prefixes
resolution_rules.access: A canonical name is not permission to cross a sheet boundary; an actual local endpoint, global access or hierarchical interface is required
resolution_rules.new_local_or_global: Resolve an existing accessible binding or explicitly create the requested kind on the target sheet; check KiCad name collisions
resolution_rules.new_hierarchical: Create through an explicit interface operation with inside/outside bindings, never by interpreting an unknown hier string as a complete connection request
resolution_rules.auto: Issued by the adapter for an existing unnamed net; copy it, do not create nets by inventing auto names
resolution_rules.page_wiring: Canonical electrical equality does not require an external wire between every pair of endpoints; preserve and plan page-level connection groups separately

object_addressing.sheet_identity: The instance path in the local context; the sheet filename is not its identity
object_addressing.sheet_detection: Exact membership in the validated sheet registry and request symbols, not part_uuid:null alone
object_addressing.real_reference_starting_with_at: Escape as @ref:/<JSON-Pointer-escaped-reference>; for example native @sheet:/ADC becomes @ref:/@sheet:~1ADC
object_addressing.pin_number: Stable string allocated to a sheet-pin UUID; do not renumber on port reorder
object_addressing.pin_name: Native hierarchical port text, e.g. AIN
object_addressing.transport: The adapter may map designators to collision-free ordinary IDs before server processing and restore every component/net/edge reference afterwards; human sheet paths must never be parsed as multipart component suffixes

request_extension_rules.merge: Add symbols and signals alongside the existing circuit and inputCircuit fields
request_extension_rules.units: Existing server coordinates: 1 unit = 0.254 mm; pin x/y relative to the layout node origin, Y down
request_extension_rules.source: A blackbox must exist in inputCircuit.components; its pins and value come from that component. Add it to the layout scene through symbols, bypassing catalog lookup
request_extension_rules.selection: A blackbox entry in symbols explicitly selects that object for the declared placement operation; inputCircuit objects alone remain external context
request_extension_rules.geometry: Cover native body, text clearances and actual pin anchors; local adapter retains offsets from node origin to native sheet body
request_extension_rules.placement: Implement and enforce supported modes; never treat an unsupported fixed constraint as movable
request_extension_rules.signals: Use signal_name as opaque identity, signals[signal_name].name for display/label sizing, and role for ground/power layout heuristics
request_extension_rules.aliases: Resolve every alias consistently in circuit and inputCircuit before dispatch; send canonical names to the server
request_extension_rules.wire_intent: Explicit page-wire connections will be an additional optional layout input; shared signal_name alone must not override a preserved sheet boundary or force a global label
request_extension_rules.output: Return virtual objects through the existing components/pins/pos and edges fields, preserving the existing response schema
request_extension_rules.native_writer: Resolve a returned blackbox by request registry and update native sheet/pin objects. Never convert it into a library symbol or a BOM/PCB component
request_extension_rules.scope_vs_role: role:power or role:ground controls layout appearance, not net scope; a local VCC must stay local

example_limits.fixtures: Illustrative JSON, not a request sent to a server or an actual KiCad project
example_limits.response_schema_example: Only checks representability in existing response schemas; empty edges are not a completed wiring result for the parent circuit above
example_limits.real_part_uuid_null: Valid for reading an existing native component; adding a sourced real component still requires its genuine part_uuid
